result:
I couldn't approve this application. I read all 20 listed images (8 full pages and 12 enlarged bands) and found no wording errors in the frozen text, but I couldn't certify every mark, so the review is incomplete. Three things limited the check:
- **Resolution:** I could only view the images as given, with no cropping or zooming. Mark-level certainty is limited to roughly the enlarged-band scale.
- **No hashes:** I had no way to compute SHA256, so neither the frozen-input hash nor the image hashes are verified.
- **Missing records:** I couldn't list directories. The 1007/1008 records and adjudications 989–1006 weren't at the paths I tried (only `user_adjudication_988.json` was found), so I couldn't check them against the pages.

The three findings most worth your attention:
1. **s38, וְאֶת after הַשָּׁמַֽיִם:** the band image looks to me like it has a line-final maqaf. The s38 source audit says high confidence there is none, and the frozen text follows the audit. I report this as a conflict and propose no change.
2. **German-rite foot note:** "In most communities of the German rite the benedictions of the Torah (page 4) are inserted here." is printed on s38 and s39. The s38 audit records it, but it is not in the frozen instructions, and its s39 copy isn't recorded anywhere.
3. **s35 repeated line:** the frozen text stores the repeated "who made me according to His will." line as a normal paragraph with no Hebrew counterpart and no sic/surplus flag.
